lines.en: : So, what do you want? Choose any one food item in the store and it’ll be my treat for pretending to help me tonight.
: Hey, for all you know, I successfully distributed roughly one hundred fliers just now. Who says I was pretending?
: Only way you could have actually handed off that many bar ads in just a few minutes is if you just conveniently waltzed into the world’s largest AA meeting.
: I think that’s the sort of place that’s supposed to make it harder to hand out bar ads.
: Yeah. You’d think that. Sad truth is that half the people that go to those meetings are ready to jump on the first fuckin’ excuse they can think of to relapse.
: Take it from someone who has experience, kid.
: I don’t know how I feel about being called “kid” when I’m only a few years younger than you.
: Right, right. My b. Just keep seein’ that baby face of yours and thinking you’re only a little older than my daughter.
: My face is not childish and I would greatly appreciate it if you’d take that back.
: And I’d greatly appreciate it if you’d get a fuckin’ move on and pick your poison already before the people workin’ here think I’m stealin’ shit.
: Are you stealing shit?
: What? No. Obviously not.
: I don’t think it’s obvious if you said yourself that people are going to be assuming that-
: I have a job now, man. I don’t have to steal shit.
: Remember? I pay bills. I’m a normal person. All that gang shit’s a thing of the past as of a little while ago.
: You can’t even name all of your bills yet.
: Well, forgive me for not fuckin’ memorizing ‘em.
: You have any idea what the longest time I’ve held down an apartment is? Go on. Take a guess.
: I feel like anything I guess here is bound to offend you.
: Three months.
: In all fairness, it should probably be two. But I’m pretty sure the owner of the place I’m talkin’ about was too scared to remind me that I actually needed to pay.
: How do you keep finding living arrangements with such a horrible track record as a tenant?
: How do you keep finding preppy girls with perky tits ready to jump your bones despite being twice their age? Just happens. Best not to question any of it.
: I’m glad to hear you’ve been...paying attention to my students’ chests?
: They’re fuckin’ teenagers, man. Their bodies ain’t had time to get all mature and saggy and shit yet. Just safe to assume, you know?
: At the risk of you hitting me, I’d like to say I wouldn’t go as far as describing you as “mature and saggy.”
: I’d sure fuckin’ hope not.
: Might not be the same as they were back when I was Yumi’s age, but there’s still some life left in these things for now.
: Maybe cause I’ve been goin’ to the gym?
: I don’t know. What do you think?
: Uhhhhhhhh...
: Sup?
: Not...much? I just didn’t expect you of all people to wind up groping yourself in the middle of a convenience store.
: Wanna cop a feel yourself?
: There is no way this isn’t a trap.
: Oh, stop. It’s not like I was planning on putting you in an arm lock the second you reached for my chest or anything. That would have just been rude.
I take a moment to thank my intuition and self control for at least improving in...some sort of way recently.
: Color me surprised, man. You normally don’t waste any time at all when it comes to hittin’ on me for whatever reason.
: And here I was actually givin’ you a chance, only for you to pussy out. You’re all talk after all, ain’t ya?
: I’m definitely not all talk. You’re just being suspiciously handsy and surprisingly flirty for someone who’s apparently not interested in romance or sex or anything.
: Well, apart from keeping me at the top of your secret sex list, I mean.
: Handsy? The fuck you talkin’ about?
: Probably the hand you’re repeatedly tapping me with.
: That’s just me fuckin’ with you, dude. Just because a girl touches you doesn’t mean she’s tryin’ to sleep with you.
: Sure. Just like how girls who pick on boys in school by pushing them around on the playground don’t actually have crushes on whoever they’re bullying.
: I didn’t, at least. I used to pick on kids just for lookin’ weird and shit.
Is bullying just a genetic trait for the Yamaguchi family or something?
Well, I guess Yuki’s maiden name would be something different...but I’m not really in any rush to figure out whatever it was.
: There. Do you feel a little safer now that the big, bad ex-biker lady isn’t trying to take your lunch money?
: The fact that you were offering to buy me dinner just a minute ago is making this sudden roleplay thing a little harder to follow.
: Still offering. Just waiting for you to fucking pick something instead of waiting for me to keep “flirting” with you.
: But the flirting is so much more fun.
: Maybe if it was actual flirting and not just two friends going on a late night sandwich run after work.
: This late night sandwich run is probably the closest you’ve been to being on an actual date literally ever.
: Yo! That ain’t even remotely-
: ...true?
: You seem confused.
: Hold on. I’m tryin’ to think.
: Well, shit. I think you’re right.
: I’m sure there were some in the past, but either I was too fucking high to remember ‘em or they just weren’t worth rememberin’ in the first place.
: So now what? Wanna hold hands or somethin’? Take turns tellin’ each other what we like about each other?
: Is the opportunity to grope you still on the table?
: Only if you don’t mind gettin’ your dick ripped off the second you try.
: Like mother, like daughter, I guess...
: Wha-
: Uh-oh.
: Yumi...
It appears that yet another unfortunate coincidence has befallen me once again.
Well, I suppose it’s not really unfortunate for me. At least not yet.
I’m sure the inevitable fallout of this will result in Yumi’s problems finding a way to bring me down in one way or another.
But, on the bright side, this might actually be kind of convenient for Yuki if she ever plans on patching things up with her daughter.
She just needs to make sure she doesn’t do anything to set her off during what I expect will be an incredibly short conversation.
Or...maybe not even a conversation at all?
: ...I’ll be the one to talk, I guess.
: Hi, Yumi.
: Yeah. Hi.
: Would you mind explaining what you’re doing all the way in bumfuck nowhere with her?
: This is the most populated part of the city and you have weird criteria for what constitutes “bumfuck nowhere.”
: As for why I’m with her-
: We’re on a date.
Oh no.
: What are you doing?
: Hm? Flirting, obviously.
: You expect me to believe that you two are on a date?
: Even this guy, who’s one of the scummiest people I’ve ever met, would have to be drunk out of his fucking mind to even consider going on a “date” with someone like you.
: Maybe he just likes girls who are a little rougher around the edges? Don’t ask me, ask him.
: Don’t ask me. We are not on a date and I have no idea why she is doing this.
: Oh, come on. You could have at least played along a little.
: I’m already on thin ice with Yumi. The last thing I need is her thinking I’m screwing her mother when I definitely am not.
: Great. Consider yourself lucky then for not catching one of the millions of STDs the world’s greatest mom over here is carrying.
: Okay, Yuki was clearly in the wrong with pretending to date me, but-
: Nah, she’s right. Well, apart from the STD thing. I deserve whatever she throws at me.
: Besides, this is the first time she’s said anything to me in years. I’ll take what I can get.
: What you can get is the fuck away from my teacher who, coincidentally, also happens to be dating my best fucking friend.
: Wait, you never told me that.
: I thought you were fucking Yumi?
: What you can get is the fuck away from my teacher, you dumb bitch.
: Just your teacher?
: Yuki, no.
: Well, what else would he fucking be?
: Beats me. I just thought you two were screwing or something.
: You thought fucking what?
: Well...yeah. Because I’ve seen you two around together and...I don’t know. I just kinda figured there was some shit goin’ on.
: Sensei always told me that wasn’t the case, but I kinda just figured that was because I’m your mom and that would make shit real awkward for him.
: Are you fucking kidding me?
: What? It’s a misunderstanding. It’s not a big deal.
: But, uhh...apart from that...
: You...got taller?
: Yeah. It’s a little known fact, but most kids continue growing once their parents walk out on them.
: Okay, I’m just...gonna...go over there.
Yuki lets go of my collar and I quickly make my way over to the magazine rack to make it look like I’m...doing anything but being involved in this discussion.

And while I’d like to say it will only be a matter of time until one of the staff breaks things up (Which probably should be my job), it looks like the only person working really doesn’t want to get involved.
And I don’t blame them. Neither Yuki nor Yumi look particularly friendly...especially when they’re at each other’s throats.
